Beginner budgeting guide

A budget is a plan for the money you expect to receive and the money you expect to spend. Writing it down helps you see where your money goes each month.

Work out your income

Start with everything that comes in after tax, including wages, benefits and pensions.

  • Wages after tax
  • Benefits and tax credits

List your spending

Add fixed bills first, then variable costs such as food and travel. Small regular purchases add up faster than most people expect, so include them too.
